revision_review: Author audit followed by independent mathematical approval of the frozen Chapters 23-25 and all 52 claims; integration adds computational prose and evidence metadata without changing proof statements.

author_review.scope: Every displayed theorem/proposition/lemma/corollary and substantive algebraic or analytic assertion in Sections 23-25, with explicit external inputs and unproved aggregate-counting boundaries.

independent_review.scope: Local derivations, external theorem statements and convention conversions; not complete external-proof, companion-code or PDF approval.

status_definitions.derived_exact_algebra: General finite algebraic derivation author-checked; bounded symbolic examples are separate evidence.
status_definitions.derived_geometric: Geometric argument and hypotheses author-checked in the chapter.
status_definitions.derived_analytic: Analytic implication author-checked with the stated convergence or uniformity hypotheses.
status_definitions.derived_from_external_statements: Author-checked deduction using the cited source statements, without re-refereeing their complete proofs.
status_definitions.external_statement_and_derived_normaliza: Primary external statement plus explicitly checked convention conversion or selector interpretation.
status_definitions.external_statement: Externally proved result quoted at its stated scope; complete external proof not independently reviewed here.
status_definitions.conditional_analytic_statement: Implication proved under an explicitly unproved analytic hypothesis.
status_definitions.scope_boundary: Explicit distinction or open requirement; no theorem resolving it is claimed.

conventions.geometry: Closed marked oriented hyperbolic surface, curvature -1, genus >=2, except the separately identified once-punctured torus benchmark.
conventions.curves: Unoriented primitive orbital supports; positive iterate index; multicurves allow parallel copies; empty target included.
conventions.traces: Unnegated SL(2) traces, P0=2, P1=x; identity character coefficient treated separately.
conventions.counting: Thurston measure normalized by each actual integral-lamination lattice. Primitivity of a weighted lamination means gcd of geometric support multiplicities, not an unchecked coordinate gcd.
conventions.support_statistics: n(C) counts copies; r(C) counts distinct supports. They are used by different functionals.
conventions.measure_status: Coefficient measures are signed locally finite atomic measures. An orbital term at a length may cancel against another label.
conventions.uniformity: Fixed target or compact marked metric family unless a finite length cutoff and explicit constants are stated. No global moduli uniformity.

claims.title: Broken-geodesic energy and positive normal Hessian
hypotheses: Fixed closed hyperbolic surface of curvature -1; equal time subdivision within injectivity radius.
